findings: Gesture drag begins only when a single positionChange exceeds touchSlop; small movements are not accumulated toward that threshold. A smooth long drag made of sub-slop events can be treated as a tap/long press rather than a swipe. No device gesture replay was run.
Sensitivity LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH maps to 60/80/140dp thresholds, so the label HIGH requires the greatest travel. Naming intent needs resource review; measured usability is unknown.

Gesture pointerInput keys item.id and swipeDownAction but not sensitivity/full callback policy, so updated thresholds may remain captured until restart. MainContent key(item.id) correctly resets card gesture state for a different item.

Fullscreen gesture attachment uses outer coordinates, but long-press menu offset adds inner card globalPosition; when those origins differ the menu location can be shifted. No visual positioning test was run.
formatFileSize repeats the unclamped five-unit array previously found in session setup; files >=1024^5 bytes can exceed the unit index.
Folder chip disables same-parent moves by lexical equality only; canonical aliases are not resolved. Disabled chips still allow long press for folder menu.
Video TextureView is detached on AndroidView release; ExoPlayer ownership and release are handled by the earlier screen lifecycle block. No decoder/render/runtime validation was performed.
Collapsed vertical folder bar eagerly composes every target with FlowRow; other branches use lazy rows/grids or estimated bounded FlowRow. No performance gain is claimed.
